description.text:
One of the two expansions that opened the Pokémon Card Game Sword & Shield series on 6 December 2019, released together with Shield, with many Pokémon of the Galar region. The legendary Zacian V leads it: its Ability attaches up to three Metal Energy from the top of the deck to it. Lapras VMAX and Stonjourner VMAX are among the first Pokémon VMAX, with Dhelmise V, Wobbuffet V and Cramorant V and the Supporters Professor's Research and Bede. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 60, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Zacian V, Ordinary Rod and Air Balloon. In English many of its cards came out in Sword & Shield in February 2020.

Sword & Shield replaced Pokémon-GX with Pokémon V. Pokémon VMAX, modelled on the games' Dynamax and Gigantamax forms, evolve from Pokémon V with much more HP and stronger attacks, but give up three Prize cards when knocked out; they carry a new rarity mark, RRR. From this series Hyper Rare cards also include Supporters.
